skill.name: content-writer
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to write clear marketing copy for landing pages, emails, social posts, and brand messaging.
skill.summary: Creates benefit-led marketing copy with concise structure, professional voice, and clear calls to action.
skill.author: shubhamsaboo

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns across the two prompt-only files. Manual review found marketing copy guidance and a style reference, with no executable code, network access, credential handling, or prompt-injection language.

content.value_statement: Drafting persuasive copy across channels takes time and consistent judgment. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to write focused marketing messages.
actual_capabilities: Drafts copy for landing pages, emails, social media posts, and brand messaging.
Applies a conversational, professional voice with active tense and short paragraphs.
Leads copy with the main benefit and ends with a clear call to action.
Avoids jargon and unproven superlatives unless the audience expects them.
Uses included headline formulas and CTA templates from the style guide.
limitations: Does not perform independent market research or competitor analysis.
Does not verify legal, compliance, pricing, or product claims.
Does not publish content or integrate with marketing platforms.
Depends on user-provided audience, offer, proof points, and brand context.

use_cases.title: Draft a Launch Page
use_cases.description: Create a landing page section that explains the offer, main benefit, proof points, and next action.

use_cases.title: Write a Campaign Email
use_cases.description: Turn product details into a concise email with a specific promise, supporting evidence, and call to action.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Posts
use_cases.description: Generate short social copy variants that match a professional voice and avoid unsupported hype.

prompt_templates.title: Write Basic Landing Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple page section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write landing page copy for this offer: [offer]. Audience: [audience]. Main benefit: [benefit]. Proof point: [proof]. CTA: [action].

prompt_templates.title: Create Email Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a promotional email.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a promotional email for [product]. Use a professional, conversational voice. Include the main benefit, one specific proof point, and one clear CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Social Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five social media post options for [campaign]. Keep each option concise, specific, and free of unproven superlatives.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Full Campaign Messaging
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request across multiple marketing assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a campaign message set for [audience] and [offer]. Include a headline, subheadline, email intro, three social posts, and CTA options. Use proof points: [proof points].

output_examples.input: Write a headline and CTA for a project management app for small agencies.
output_examples.output: Headline: Plan every client project without losing track of the next step. CTA: Start planning your next project today.

output_examples.input: Create a short email opening for a finance dashboard launch.
output_examples.output: Your team should not need three reports to answer one cash flow question. Our new dashboard brings balances, forecasts, and alerts into one clear view.

output_examples.input: Write three social post options for a webinar registration campaign.
output: Learn how small teams build a repeatable content calendar in one hour.
Join the webinar and leave with a content plan your team can use next week.
See the planning process behind consistent campaigns, from topic choice to final schedule.

best_practices: Provide audience, offer, proof points, desired action, and channel before asking for copy.
Ask for multiple variants when testing headlines, CTAs, or social posts.
Review factual claims, pricing, and compliance language before publishing.
anti_patterns: Request generic copy without audience, offer, or proof details.
Ask for unsupported superlatives such as best or revolutionary without evidence.
Use the output as final legal, medical, financial, or compliance-approved copy.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create marketing copy for landing pages, promotional emails, social posts, and brand messaging.

faq.question: Can it match a brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide voice notes, banned words, approved examples, and audience details for better alignment.

faq.question: Does it include style guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses concise structure, active voice, specific proof, clear CTAs, and a short style guide.

faq.question: Can it verify product claims?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify claims, numbers, pricing, and regulated statements before publication.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to inspect?
faq.answer: The reviewed files are prompt-only and contain no executable code or external network behavior.
